name: OTTO Market
description: OTTO Market partner API: orders and their positions, product variations, stock and price updates, and returns for sellers on otto.de. OAuth 2.0 with the partner's client credentials.
instructions:
**Getting credentials**
1. You must already be an OTTO Market partner. In **OTTO Partner Connect** create an **app** for your own account and enable the interfaces **Orders**, **Products**, **Availability** and **Returns**. You receive a **client id** and a **client secret** (shown once; rotate it if lost).
2. Set `OTTO_USERNAME` to the **client id** and `OTTO_PASSWORD` to the **client secret**. The variable names are historical; no OTTO user name or password is involved.
3. AnythingMCP runs OTTO's client-credentials flow against `https://api.otto.market/v1/token` (form-encoded, credentials in the body) and asks for the scopes `orders products availability returns`. OTTO issues no refresh token; a new access token is fetched when the old one (30 minutes) expires. OTTO requires every interface you call to be listed as a scope, so the app must have all four enabled; if a token request fails, check the app's interfaces first.

**Every endpoint is versioned separately.** OTTO versions per resource, not per API: orders are on `/v4/orders`, products and prices on `/v5/products`, stock on `/v1/availability/quantities`, returns on `/v3/returns`. The tools below carry the version each resource is actually on — do not assume one prefix works everywhere.

**Orders page with a cursor.** `otto_market_list_orders` returns `links` with a `next` link carrying `nextcursor=...`; pass that cursor string back as `nextCursor` to walk the list. Do not compute an offset; OTTO's order stream is append-only and offsets drift. Products and returns page with `page` and `limit`.

**State the date range you mean.** `fromOrderDate` / `toOrderDate` bound the order list; without them OTTO decides the window.

**Stock and price are eventually consistent.** A price update is accepted with a 202 and a process id and applied asynchronously, so reading the value back immediately will often still show the old number. That is OTTO's design, not a failed write.

**Checked against OTTO's published OpenAPI specification** (api.otto.market/docs), not yet against a live partner account. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is welcome.

**Writes**: `otto_market_update_quantity` and `otto_market_update_price` change what shoppers on otto.de see.

tools.name: otto_market_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with their positions, buyer, delivery address and fulfilment status, optionally from/to an order date. Page by passing back the `nextcursor` value from the response's `links` (rel=next) as nextCursor.

fromOrderDate.description: Only orders newer than this date, ISO 8601 with a zone, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

toOrderDate.description: Only orders older than this date, ISO 8601 with a zone.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Restrict to orders whose position items are in this state.

nextCursor.description: The `nextcursor` value from the previous response's next link (only the cursor string). With a cursor, OTTO ignores every other filter except limit.

tools.name: otto_market_get_order
tools.description: Read one order in full: every position with SKU, price and status, the delivery and invoice addresses, and the payment method.

tools.name: otto_market_list_products
tools.description: List the seller's product variations with their SKU, EAN, product reference and category, optionally filtered. Pages with page and limit.

sku.description: Exact SKU. Use this instead of otto_market_get_product when the SKU contains / or .

productReference.description: Product reference shared by the variations of one product.

tools.name: otto_market_get_product
tools.description: Read one product variation by SKU: its attributes, category and media. For a SKU containing / or . use otto_market_list_products with sku instead.

tools.name: otto_market_list_quantities
tools.description: Read the current stock quantities OTTO holds for the seller's SKUs (up to 200 per page), so a discrepancy with the ERP can be spotted.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: the last SKU of the previous response. With a cursor, only limit is considered.

tools.name: otto_market_list_returns
tools.description: List returned position items by return status, with their SKU, reason and the order they belong to — the input to any returns-rate question.

tools.name: otto_market_update_quantity
tools.description: Set the available stock for one SKU, as OTTO's availability interface holds it.

tools.name: otto_market_update_price
tools.description: Set the standard price for one SKU. OTTO answers 202 with a process id and applies the change asynchronously; shoppers on otto.de see it once it has been processed.
